video_title: Roommates EXCLUSIVE❗Jim Dolan's Motivational Speech Before The Knicks 2026 NBA Championship Run

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on why owners should not talk to players
quotes.excerpt: owners really shouldn't talk to the team's players, because they don't know
quotes.quote: I really debated whether to come talk to you, because owners really shouldn't talk to the team's players, because they don't know. And I don't purport to know a whole ton about basketball, even though I've been doing it for 30 years.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan believes the current Knicks team can win a championship
quotes.excerpt: I believe that this team can go all the way
quotes.quote: I believe that this team can go all the way. And in my 30 years of doing this, I've never felt closer to achieving that goal than right now. This team can win it all.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the life-changing impact of winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: It would be life-changing for all of you. It will stick with you the rest of your lives.
quotes.quote: I don't know if you understand what it would mean for you to win a championship this year, to win the NBA championship. It would be life-changing for all of you. It will stick with you the rest of your lives. And if you don't win, you'll be thinking about it the rest of your lives.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the lasting legacy of being an NBA champion
quotes.excerpt: you will forever, ever be a part of New York City.
quotes.quote: To get a ring, to have your, ultimately, have your numbers up on the rafters, right, you will forever, ever be a part of New York City. No matter where you go and what you do, the rest of your lives, when people introduce you, even if you become the President of the United States, right, they'll start off with NBA Champion 2026. I guarantee it.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan on the coaching change from Tom Thibodeau
quotes.excerpt: coach Thibodeau was a great coach, brilliant, but we thought that you needed a coach
quotes.quote: Coach Thibodeau was a great coach, brilliant, but we thought that you needed a coach that would pull you together, that would have you play as a team. And although it's not been perfect, we believe that together, a joint effort would be better for the team.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan tells players to stop talking to the press
quotes.excerpt: Stop talking to the press. Instead, talk to each other.
quotes.quote: Stop talking to the press. Instead, talk to each other. The press doesn't mean anything. You want to communicate to your teammates, you want to communicate to the staff, do it. But forget the press. It doesn't matter what the public thinks of you.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan's advice on player preparation and practice
quotes.excerpt: You need to up your practice. You need to pay more attention to your diet.
quotes.quote: You need to up your practice. You need to pay more attention to your diet. You need to sleep better. You need to be ready for every game.

quotes.speaker: Jim Dolan
quotes.summary_phrase: Jim Dolan identifies three key areas for the Knicks to improve
quotes.excerpt: first quarter focus, defensive pick and rolls, and a rebound.
quotes.quote: I know there are others, but I only know three. Fix those three. The next 10 days, fix those three things as part of your focus. Do whatever you have to do personally, do whatever you have to do interpersonally, but fix those three things because those are our Achilles heels, and they'll stop us in the playoffs.
